name: Proxmox VE Self-Hosted Virtualization
free_limit: Open-source self-hosted virtualization platform for KVM virtual machines and LXC containers, with web management, clustering, storage and software-defined networking; no vendor-side per-VM allowance or time limit.
watch_out: Requires your own physical servers, CPU, RAM, storage, networking and administration; this is NOT a free cloud-hosted VPS. The no-subscription repository lacks the tested Enterprise Repository, and commercial support and enterprise updates require paid subscriptions. AGPLv3 license obligations apply.
